ctx.x: Oh, everything under the sun, even props for the stage for the plays we gave and we had and, oh, and barrels and barrels of candy, you know. Oh, I remember all --

Yes, it was really nice, and they -- these two women organized -- this thing going, and it was really something. And I used to -- I remember now, Dr. Dickenson, he was -- oh, what a man! He reminded me so much in voice later on that I got out of school of the Barrymores.

items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Milt, and Eddie, and the guy they called Chops.

ctx.x: Oh, you did? I don't think we ever mentioned Eddie. When did you work with Eddie?

I worked with Eddie here -- what year I was in the Apollo Theater. Every time he came in the Apollo theater he had to augment the band. I would work with him, and he asked me to come on the road with him, which I didn't do, but several times here in New York, in the Apollo I worked with him, and (snaps fingers) Milt Hinton was in the band. I worked with Milt, and Eddie, and the guy they called Chops.
